label: D1 after a reward, while leaning toward a2, early in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (88% of mass) and never at GO. At D1 it needs the reward input: 99% of mass follows a rewarded previous trial. Within that it is gated by the policy leaning moderately to a2 (choice logit about -4.4 to -1.5 holds 80% of mass; upcoming action a2 holds 93%), by mid-range value (7.1-7.7), and strongly by episode time: high in trials 3-49, fading after 50 and silent after 80, so magnitude drifts slowly over the episode. Over a run of rewarded a2 trials the activation often climbs step by step. The remaining 12% of mass is weak D2 firing, mostly at S1 after choosing a2 (a rare transition). Recorded predicate uses only observed or self-computed variables (the policy logit and trial count, no future variables). Dev F1 0.65, mass recall 0.77. Phase+reward alone reaches mass recall 0.97 but precision 0.2. Adding the a2 lean and ep_trial<50 is what lifts precision. Does not fire after unrewarded trials, at GO, or late in episodes.
